name: Hino Kurumi
source:
Kurumi spends most of her time gardening and respects [url=/c98378]Midori[/url] for being able to talk to plants. Once she gets into something, she has the habit of not looking at her surroundings, which causes her to fail at a lot of things. Even if something gets her down, her straightforward personality makes her quick to rise back up. Kurumi is terrible at cooking and volunteers as a school nurse.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
